items.note: S1.3.1 states y_S -> y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch values with the subtract/add/undo reason of lines 705-708, 744-750, and S1.3.2 states the signed exchange with restoration. Missing: h=100, N, m, the net coefficient (JV+RG)x with central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, the inverse schedule at stage 2 and the three-stage computation (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x) (761-763).

States D_out S D_in^{-1} and the route operator, but drops the scalar sign epsilon_w (820-822) and does not give the reason (a common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, 809-813) or that one frame serves all incidences of a gate.

Correct on the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h), on Wm-2N+2L and on L<N/2. It omits the bilinear forms, the triple-indicator orthogonality, the F^{⊗3} labels, L=Ich and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. It also calls Wm-2N+2L the 'summed dimension change' when it is the sum of absolute changes (894, 1066-1071).

States the endpoint difference I_m on every role and s_b<W_b m. It omits the negative source matrix -P_{U_a} that the identity needs (1117, 1169-1170, 1472) and the formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and it calls the projections 'frames' (the frames are Phi_M).

Has the phase frame, one kernel aI+bX_v per residual basis vector and s_c<W_c m. It omits that the basis is orthonormal, that kernels may be inverses, and the formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. It claims C^{⊗m} on every role without the source and sink diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange (1225-1226).

States L<N/2, s<Wm for both networks and tau=1-2^{-50} 'such as'. It gives neither the deficits eta_b, eta_c and the bound eta>20·2^{-50} with log m<20 nor the condition s/W<m^tau that justifies the value.

S1.1 matches Lemma elementary-streams. S1.2 drops the hypothesis that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time and the prime/denominator conditions on q, although its quoted line carries the first.
Both lemmas are stated faithfully: A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, and the shear with exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V). The elimination proof and the three-update interchange trick are not given.

Follows the route: W role streams, edges as recursive interchanges of width e/m, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). Missing: the condition that the row field is divisible by W^k, the use of the frame identity to get H<-H+D on every row, the conversion of the shear to an interchange (D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, 1535-1541) and the fixed-tape schedule.

States O(Vu^tau) and sketches the paper's route: interchange high digits, pad rows to a multiple of W^k, split the rest in base m. It omits that the joined high digits form the row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k and the padding of binary ranges to [q^e].

Has the kernels along an orthonormal residual basis, the invertible address change P_M, H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, and s children on 1/m of the axes. It omits the exponents epsilon_j and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z (1885-1888), and does not say that the basis changes are row additions.

Qualitatively correct: a constant number (eight) of cyclic shifts, repair of an explicit exceptional set, and a restored third chunk. It gives no positions j_i=rho+iK, no delta_bad and no cost bound O(V(L^tau+1)).

Only the method's phrase 'recurse on 1/m of the axes after splitting rows among the wires'. There is no recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), no leaf rule, no q_0 row index and no unrolling to d^{lambda'}.

States O(Vd^{lambda'}), exact evaluation with guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) and one final truncation, and the method follows the paper's route. It misses the recurrence and its unrolling (lambda' > sigma+beta(1-sigma)), K=floor(d^c) and the error bound sqrt2·2^{-p}.

omega_t=y^{2r/t}, F^+F^-=t^{-1}I and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+ell d^{lambda'}]) are correct. It omits the bit-reversed order and the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and gives no error bound.

Has packing at 2^{4p}, the O(N log N) multiplier, centered coefficients and the wrap. 'Integer parts' loosely means the integer numerators of the real and imaginary parts, and the output Q_p(fg/r) and the cost O(rp log(rp)) are not stated.

Has the right structure (two forward transforms, pointwise products in the retained order, the opposite transform) and the commutation reason. It says 'with explicit error bound' without the bound sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p}, and omits the exact scale by M and the cost.
The identities P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A, the error and the time are correct. It omits the hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 and the definitions of P_s, P_t.
Both identities (eq:permuted-chirp, eq:source-permutation-cancel) are reproduced exactly. The chirp a_j itself is not written out.

Has b, p=6b, d, K, t_i, Tp=Theta(n), the prime window and T/2<S<T. It writes T≈n/b instead of the power of two in [4n/b,8n/b), and omits eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma, and the fixed rationals other than tau and kappa.
Has Phi: x->prod x_i^{mu_i}, the isomorphism preserving convolution, and the triangular controlled shifts. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the triangular formula and the cost are absent.
Coefficient k times zeta^k with zeta=e^{pi i/r} as an isomorphism C[x]/(x^r-1)->C[y]/(y^r+1), used on the last axis and then untwisted: matches the paper.

The source transform (A, chirp via twist, B_0, 2^gamma) matches. The algorithm drops the 2^{-b-2} digit scaling and gives the final rescale as 'S and 2^{2b+4}', where the paper multiplies by S and then by 2^{2b+4}S (4517-4522).
States error <1/2, exact rounding and carries, but gives none of the bounds (E_s=9·2^gamma TL, E_w<28·2^gamma T^2 L, 448b·2^{-3b/4}) or the role of gamma<=b/4 and p=6b.

Correct that the seven powers are <=1-2kappa, the minimum margin is 2^{-181}, kappa=2^{-182} and polylog is absorbed. The seven cost terms are not listed and the binding margin g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) is not identified.
S0 only lists nlogn-conjecture as a dependency. The liminf form of the negation and the fact that the bound gives limit zero are absent.

errors.says: With projection matrices of the labels as frames, every input role sees the same matrix difference I_m.
errors.paper: The source X_a is assigned -P_{U_a}, not the projection of its label; with P_{U_a} the X_a->Y_a difference would be P_{U_a^perp}-P_{U_a}≠I_m. This negative source projection is essential and costs the extra N source ranks in s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. The frames are the shears Phi_M, not the projections.

errors.says: the whole network equals C^{⊗m} on every role
errors.paper: C^{⊗m} holds only after source and sink diagonal corrections (Z_{a,k}, i^{27k}) and undoing the signed bank exchange; the raw X_a->Y_a route has C^{-1} on 27 coordinates.

errors.says: a route sends input role w to D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}
errors.paper: The route applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, with the scalar sign of the signed permutation (nontrivial in the complex network).

errors.says: the summed dimension change is Wm-2N+2L
errors.paper: The signed sum of dimension changes is Wm-2N. Wm-2N+2L is the sum of absolute changes.

errors.says: Three invocations at stages 1, 2 and 3 ... realize the signed exchange
errors.paper: Stage 2 runs the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (X<-X-Y), and each stage consists of v^2 invocations (I=3v^2).
The opposite transform's output is multiplied by S, and then by 2^{2b+4}S, undoing the 1/S^2 of the cancellation identity and the 2^{-b-2} digit scaling.
T is the power of two in [4n/b,8n/b).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: the two network procedures (S1), the synthetic transforms and convolution (S2), resampling with Bluestein and permutation cancellation (S3), and parameters, exactness and accounting (S4) reach O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins at the central saving. The step from the label budget Wm-2N+2L to s_b=Wm-N+2L_b, through the negative source projection, is missing and is misstated in S1.3.5. L/N=100/539 and the eta-based choice of tau are absent, and the butterfly layer's recurrence is only named. Exact recovery and time accounting are asserted without their bounds.

steps.note: Gives banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of every auxiliary wire. h=100, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are not stated.
D_out S D_in^{-1} and 'only changes of frame along edges cost work' are present. The commuting mechanism and the sign epsilon_w are missing.
Nested nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional space; the only decreasing edges are the central wires 3->4, each losing h. The F^{⊗3} construction and the bilinear forms are not given.
Only 'dimension changes count the cost of edges'. There is no rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the N rank-one source exceptions are absent and contradicted by S1.3.5's plain projections.
Wm-2N+2L appears (labelled loosely as the summed change), but L=Ich and the rank budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b do not.
L<N/2 and s<Wm are asserted separately. The ratios 100/539 and 101/539 and the deficit N-2L>0 that links them are absent.
I_m on every input role and the address shear are stated. The matrix assignment that makes it true (-P_{U_a} at X_a sources) is misdescribed.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), edge shears by recursive interchanges, and s calls per node.
Volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), growth m^{k tau} with tau=1-2^{-50}. The justification of tau from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, and the explicit condition s/W<m^tau, are missing.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the outer frame of the saving: the fixed exchanging network, frames, nested labels with the single decreasing edge class, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The arithmetic core that makes s<Wm true is missing: rank equals dimension change, the N extra source ranks giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and L/N=100/539<1/2. S1.3.5's use of plain projections hides the negative source matrix that the endpoint identity needs.
